desc_en: Ancient coral city with 7th-century mosques including Al-Qiblatayn, standing at the crossroads of ancient maritime trade.
desc_so: Magaalo qadiimi ah oo leh masaajiddii qarnigii 7aad sida Masjidka Qiblatayn, kuna taallay jaddada ganacsiga baha ee qadiimiga ah.

desc_en: Enchanting misty cloud forests reaching 2,400m altitude with breathtaking precipices overlooking the Gulf of Aden.
desc_so: Kaymo buuro ah oo leh daruuro u dhow 2,400m oo ka kor muuqda Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadan.

desc_en: The easternmost point of mainland Africa, famous for historic salt works, ancient Trade ports, and dramatic oceanic scenery.
desc_so: Qeebta ugu bariiga sanyada qaaradda Afrika, oo caan ku ah cusbada taariikhiga ah iyo xeebaha qadiimiga ah.

desc_en: Unspoiled coral reef marine sanctuary known for its turquoise waters, historical tomb markers, and sea turtle nesting sites.
desc_so: Jaziirad caan ku ah sanadaha baha, badweynta buluugga ah, iyo goobaha beeyada iyo taariikhda.

desc_en: Where high mountain ranges drop dramatically into turquoise Indian Ocean waters, renowned for seafood traditions.
desc_so: Meel buuraha Cal Madow ay si toos ah uga fariistaan xeebta badda, ee caanka ku ah suuqyada kalluunka.

desc_en: Historic Sultanate port town surrounded by golden coastal sand dunes and untouched Indian Ocean beaches.
desc_so: Magaalo dekad ah oo taariikhi ah oo ay ku xeeran yihiin dhoobada ciidda dahabiga ah iyo xeebaha badweynta.
